recommended_action: Design a real CDN correctness experiment: deploy the same mock OAuth2 server behind Cloudflare or Fastly with auth-aware cache configuration, brotli+gzip compression enabled, and chunked transfer-encoding. Repeat the correctness controls (SHA256(decompressed) == SHA256(generate_*_body)) with the same 4 auth states and 3 content types, but now through real CDN infrastructure with Accept-Encoding negotiation, CDN-specific headers (X-Cache, Via, ETag), geographic latency, and production concurrency. This is the mandatory next gate for C-MEAS-VALID product readiness. If CDN correctness passes, C-MEAS-VALID can advance toward Product Core. If it fails, the decompression pipeline requires diagnosis. Alternatively, in parallel, test larger payloads (10KB/100KB) under correctness controls to determine if gzip/brotli dictionary references cross chunk boundaries causing decompression failure at scale.
